description: Per-organization AI API key storage - users can paste their own API key in the config page instead of using Vercel env vars
steps: Add aiApiKey and ollamaUrl fields to Organization model in Prisma schema
Update GET /api/settings/ai to return hasApiKey (boolean) based on org DB field
Update PUT /api/settings/ai to accept and save apiKey and ollamaUrl
Update config page to show password input for API key and URL input for Ollama
Update createAIProvider factory to accept optional apiKey parameter
Update GeminiProvider and NvidiaProvider constructors to accept apiKey
Update OllamaProvider to accept custom baseUrl
Update AI API routes (lineamientos, chat) to read org key from DB and pass to provider
acceptance_criteria: Organization model has aiApiKey (String?) and ollamaUrl (String?) fields
GET /api/settings/ai returns hasApiKey boolean without exposing actual key
PUT /api/settings/ai saves apiKey to org.aiApiKey in DB
Config page shows masked key (****last4) when key exists
Config page has password input for Gemini/NVIDIA and URL input for Ollama
createAIProvider accepts optional apiKey and ollamaUrl parameters
Providers use passed apiKey or fall back to process.env
AI routes read org settings from DB and pass to createAIProvider
API key is never exposed in GET responses or logs
